name: Benelux
description: A horizontal tricolour of red, white and blue, charged at the centre with a gold lion rampant standing partly on a black panel.
history: Commissioned in the 1950s by the Committee for Belgian–Dutch–Luxembourgish Cooperation from a Dutch flag maker; sources date it to 1951 or to about 1957. It combines the three national tricolours with the lion that appears in all three coats of arms. The Benelux Union has never formally adopted it as an official flag, though it is widely used for the union.

features.symbolism: the colours shared by the flags of Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg
the lion common to the arms of all three states
